title: Cancel a batch that is still running

cancelled.reason: the batch runner is being replaced; a cancel key there would be dead code

intent.outcome: A batch can be stopped while it runs
intent.problem: a wrong batch ran to the end

acceptance_criteria.description: a running batch stops on the cancel key
acceptance_criteria.verification: grep -c '"cancel"' fixtures/gateway.json && echo "the gateway file knows cancel"

steps.action: stop the batch on the key
steps.done_when: the batch stops where it is
